translations.desc_legacy_101: 🏛️ Classic: Upstream original cushion/sprint logic. Cashout if next double overshoots 19,800; sprint above.
translations.desc_three_stages: 💰 3-Stage: Maximize → controlled wins → maximize. Upstream original phased strategy.
translations.desc_max_profit: 🏆 Max Profit: Cushion to 19,800 then sprint for 10k+ final win. Target ~30,000-32,000 daily.
translations.desc_fastest_clear: ⚡ Fastest: All-or-nothing max double-up every round. Only cashout at 20k+. Highest risk, fastest done.
translations.desc_balanced: ⚖️ Balanced: Build (3.2-6.4k cashouts) → Push (10k threshold) → Sprint. Reliable ~25,000.
translations.desc_aggressive_balanced: 💪 Aggressive: Like Balanced but pushes harder. Lower win-rate floors, bigger cashouts. Target ~28-30k.
translations.desc_adaptive_rush: 🔄 Adaptive: Starts all-in like Fastest, auto-downshifts to safe cushion if too many fails.
translations.desc_grinder: 🛡️ Grinder: Ultra-safe, never doubles more than 4x. Slow grind to 19,800 then one final sprint.
translations.desc_custom_parametric: ⚙️ Custom: Fine-tune your own win rate, cushion targets, and max doubles.
